answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying voting weight to locked stake rather than headcount. Each agent posts collateral to mint one signed identity and emits a steady pulse of attestations; weight is linear in the bonded amount, so splitting capital across a swarm of fake opal accounts leaves total influence unchanged while multiplying fees. Any double-vote or forged attestation triggers slashing that burns the culprit's staked ember, so an attacker loses more in forfeited collateral than the fake identities could ever earn.
